1.consolidated_definition: Cultivado, avanzado. Persona refinada y muy educada; refiriéndose a un aparato o equipo, muy complejo y elaborado. El inglés actúa de elemento difusor. Frecuente. DRAE: desde 1992. Porque su pasión es volar aviones, a pesar de que por el momento ha tenido que conformarse con hacerlo mediante un sofisticado programa computadorizado que compró y con el cual mata sus ratos libres (CREA PR, Vea Online, 11-05-03)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Refined and highly educated person; referring to a device or equipment, very complex and sophisticated.

 Cultivated, advanced. Person refined and very educated; referring to an apparatus or equipment, very complex and elaborated.

The English acts as a disseminator element. Frequent. DRAE: since 1992.

Because his passion is flying airplanes, despite the fact that for the moment he has had to settle for doing it through a sophisticated computerized program that he bought and with which he kills his free time (CREA PR, Vea Online, 11-05-03)
